nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Tailwind v4 integration entry for the UI package: imports the tailwindcss package theme/utilities (with the scanning root widened to the package root), the shared styles/index.css design system, and the local tailwind utilities/colors, then declares an @theme block that wipes Tailwind's defaults (--*: initial) and re-registers spacing, breakpoints, containers, fonts, text sizes, radii, shadows, and the pulse animation as aliases of the project's design-token variables.
nodes.languageNotes: Tailwind v4 CSS-first configuration: --*: initial disables the default theme so only project tokens generate utilities, and @import "tailwindcss/utilities.css" ... source("../../../../") expands Tailwind's content scanning beyond the stylesheet's own directory.

nodes.name: colors.css
nodes.summary: Generated bridge (by script/tailwind.ts, do-not-edit) that registers ~230 --color-* theme tokens — background, surface, text, input, border, button, icon, syntax, and markdown families — each aliasing the matching semantic CSS variable from styles/theme.css, after removing Tailwind's default color palette with --color-*: initial.
nodes.languageNotes: Purely mechanical var(--x) to --color-x aliasing: it makes utilities like bg-surface-base or text-interactive-base consume themed variables that automatically flip with prefers-color-scheme, so regeneration (not hand-editing) is the only supported change path.

nodes.name: utilities.css
nodes.summary: Custom Tailwind v4 @utility definitions: no-scrollbar, badge-mask and badge-mask-tight (radial-gradient corner-notched masks), truncate-start, and fade-up-text with the 30-step staggered animation-delay ladder — the Tailwind-native counterparts of the plain classes in styles/utilities.css and styles/animations.css.
nodes.languageNotes: Tailwind v4's @utility at-rule makes these first-class utilities that compose with variants (hover:, md:, group-...) unlike plain classes; fade-up-text resolves its fadeUp keyframes from styles/animations.css at runtime.
